name: Katagiri Megumi
source:
A reserved and precocious girl. Because she tries hard not to display her feelings, she is hard to read. She is also one of Akeno's closest friends and also her childhood friend.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kusari]Wikipedia[/url]]
